definition: A worksheet used to report nondeductible contributions to traditional IRAs, distributions from traditional IRAs, conversions from traditional IRAs to Roth IRAs, and distributions from Roth IRAs, including basis calculations and special repayment provisions.

includes.text: Form contains sections for reporting nondeductible IRA contributions and traditional IRA distributions
includes.quote: Nondeductible contributions to a traditional IRA

includes.text: Form includes parts for Roth IRA conversions and Roth IRA distributions
includes.quote: Conversions from traditional IRAs to Roth IRAs

includes.text: Form contains line-by-line instructions for calculating basis in IRAs
includes.quote: Basis in Regular Roth IRA Contributions Worksheet

excludes.text: Does not allocate qualified business income deduction among multiple beneficiaries
Does not report capital gains and losses from investment transactions
Does not report mortgage interest paid by borrowers

discriminators.text: Reports IRA contribution basis and distribution taxation rather than computing qualified business income deduction
discriminators.quote: Nondeductible contributions you made to traditional IRAs

discriminators.text: Calculates IRA basis and distribution treatment rather than reporting investment capital gains and losses
discriminators.quote: Distributions from traditional IRAs, if you have a basis in these IRAs

discriminators.text: Reports IRA contributions and distributions rather than mortgage interest paid during the tax year
